nodes.label: IPAddress Cast Patch For Ethernet 2.0.2
nodes.rationale: The Zephyr core ships its own arduino::IPAddress, making IPAddress(0ul) ambiguous against three constructors. Fix is an explicit cast at each call site in EthernetClient.cpp, in both branches of the ESP8266/ESP32 #if.

nodes.label: Use SMS_STS, Never SCSCL
nodes.rationale: SCSCL is the SC series and its register map differs: mode is at address 19 there, 33 here.

nodes.label: Vendored Arduino Libraries
nodes.rationale: Patched Ethernet and SCServo live in libraries/ and are referenced by sketch.yaml so nothing is fetched at build time. The folder name must match the sketch.yaml entry.
